segments.name: Financial Services
segments.description: Operates Snap-on Credit LLC and other finance subsidiaries, providing financing to customers purchasing or leasing tools, diagnostics and equipment and to franchisees for vehicle and business needs.
segments.evidence: Financial Services consists of the business operations of Snap-on Credit LLC ("SOC"), the company's financial services business in the United States, and Snap-on's other financial services subsidiaries in those international markets where Snap-on has franchise operations.

revenueModel.text: Professional customers, franchisees and distributors pay Snap-on for tools, diagnostics, equipment and repair information sold through franchisee vans, direct and distributor channels, while Financial Services earns revenue from financing extended-term payment plans and franchisee needs.
revenueModel.evidence: The company also provides financing programs to facilitate the sales of its products and to support its franchise business.
